The food looks like scrambled egg whites, or possibly egg-white scramble, in chunks on a square plate. The plate is about 22-24 cm across, and the food covers roughly 60% of it as a modest pile about 2-3 cm high.

For volume, the pile is roughly 14 cm by 15 cm by 2.5 cm. Allowing for gaps between chunks, that is about 300-400 ml, so I estimate about 200 g of food.

Egg whites run about 52 kcal per 100 g, so 200 g is about 105 kcal. The chunks look slightly creamy, so there may be some added fat or whole egg. I'll estimate 130 kcal.
